description: Drag Blaze back on the slingshot and SMASH crystal towers! Chain destructions for COMBO multipliers with screen-shake and particle explosions.
fireSafetyLesson: Never throw things at others — aim only at safe targets, and never play with real fire!
title: Sizzle's Spark Run

description: Blaze auto-rolls upward through a volcanic cavern! Tap left/right to dodge lava geysers and grab embers. Speed keeps rising!
fireSafetyLesson: Lava is always pretend in games — real hot liquids cause serious burns. Never touch!
title: Blaze's Inferno Roll

description: Bumper arena chaos! Smash your fire baby into rivals to knock them out of the ring. Most knockouts in 60 seconds wins!
fireSafetyLesson: Playful bumping is for games only — never push or shove real people!
title: Ruko's Speed Trap

description: Rhythm tap challenge! Boulders roll down 4 lanes — tap each exactly in the glowing strike zone. Perfect timing builds COMBO streaks!
fireSafetyLesson: Timing matters! When the smoke alarm beeps, act FAST — get out right away!
title: Boulder's Blockade

description: Endless hopper! Tap to make Cinder hop between sliding ice platforms. Chain perfect landings for combo multipliers — don't fall!
fireSafetyLesson: Slippery floors are dangerous — walk, don't run, on wet surfaces!
title: Cinder's Slide

description: Castle defense! Aim the ballista and fire water bolts at incoming smoke monsters. Survive 8 waves to save the castle!
fireSafetyLesson: Firefighters are the heroes who battle real blazes — always let grown-ups handle fire!
title: Lord Inferno's Strike

description: Match-3 drop puzzle! Tap a column to drop an ember — match 3+ of the same color to blast them with combo multipliers!
fireSafetyLesson: Sorting and organizing keeps things safe — keep matches sorted away from kids!
title: Magma Jump 2D

description: Endless dodge & collect! Steer Pyra with touch or arrows — dodge smoke clouds, grab stars. Speed keeps rising!
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke is dangerous — if you see smoke, get LOW under it and get OUT!
title: Pyra Prime Dash

description: Tug-of-war showdown! RAPIDLY TAP to pull the rope and drag the boulder over YOUR line before the rival team does!
fireSafetyLesson: Teamwork saves lives! In an emergency, help each other get to safety!
title: Ash Heap Hero

description: Speedrun platformer! Race right through the volcanic track, grab all 8 stars, and hit the finish flag. Fastest time wins!
fireSafetyLesson: Running fast is fun in games — but in a real fire, WALK quickly and never push!
title: Thermal Track

description: Swinging grapple arcade! Tap to shoot your grapple at anchors, then release at the perfect moment to fling Cinder to targets!
fireSafetyLesson: Ropes and swings are playground fun — never swing near fires or hot stoves!
title: Ember Bounce Master

description: Grid tactics! 10 turns to place water drops — splash 3+ connected lava tiles to cool them. Cool the most tiles to win!
fireSafetyLesson: Water cools fire! But only grown-ups and firefighters should battle real flames!
title: Volcanic Target

description: Physics destroyer! Launch Blaze at wobbling rock towers and watch them topple with realistic tilt physics. 5 shots!
fireSafetyLesson: Throwing is for safe targets only — never aim at people or animals!
title: Lava Rush Arcade

description: Vertical free-fall runner! Ruko drops down the volcano shaft — steer left/right to dodge ledges and grab embers!
fireSafetyLesson: Falling is scary — always use handrails on stairs and never play near cliffs!
title: Flame Drop Physics

description: Arena bumper rematch! Ram smoke-puff rivals out of the ring. You vs 2 AI — most knockouts in 60 seconds takes the crown!
fireSafetyLesson: Bumping is for games — in real life, keep your hands to yourself!
title: Blaze's Zenith

description: THE GRAND FINALE! Three epic phases: rhythm boulders, lane dash, and slingshot gate-smashing. Survive them all to become a Fire Babys LEGEND!
fireSafetyLesson: Legends stay safe! Know your escape plan, test alarms monthly, and NEVER play with fire!
title: Ruko's Final Dash
